rec1m3Xu6scfMDz1E.name: Gary Anello
rec1m3Xu6scfMDz1E.summary: Gary is a career and executive coach who has worked internationally as a trainer and facilitator for over 20 years. He draws on theatre, storytelling, and human rights work to help leaders build authenticity, presence, and impact across cultures.
rec1m3Xu6scfMDz1E.ideal_client: People making a career transition at any level, plus emerging leaders and established leaders rethinking how they work.

recMugaEC2yqI2A0s.name: Jake Randall
recMugaEC2yqI2A0s.summary: Jake is a financial coach who helps people see where their money goes and get clear on their next financial step. He breaks the work into manageable action steps and provides accountability, after paying off more than $100k of his own student loans.
recMugaEC2yqI2A0s.ideal_client: People early in their careers, often in their twenties, who want to get organized with money and feel more in control.
recMugaEC2yqI2A0s.offer: Helps people build a cash flow plan, pay off debt, build an emergency fund, prepare to buy a first home, and negotiate salary and bills.

recXjBhaXUD3Zu9xH.name: Neela Pirwitz
recXjBhaXUD3Zu9xH.summary: Neela is a certified coach focused on burnout prevention, wellbeing, and sustainable productivity. She works with professionals who feel overwhelmed or stuck, drawing on a background in psychology and strategic innovation management.
recXjBhaXUD3Zu9xH.ideal_client: Ambitious professionals who want to succeed at work while keeping space for relationships, wellbeing, and what matters to them.
recXjBhaXUD3Zu9xH.offer: Helps people gain clarity, shift unhelpful patterns, and build healthier boundaries and habits for a sustainable way of working.

recsse6OHYIt624QR.name: Denise Foss
recsse6OHYIt624QR.summary: Denise is a life, mindset, and leadership coach who works with people at a career or creative pivot point, when something no longer fits and they are ready to change direction. She blends clarity, mindset, and structure to help them move without burning out.
recsse6OHYIt624QR.ideal_client: Ambitious, multi-passionate professionals, often creatives or leaders, navigating transition, growth, or reinvention.
recsse6OHYIt624QR.offer: Helps people find clear direction and sustainable momentum, so performance and wellbeing fit together.

recknhqT4WSlXYkeE.name: Brittany Schmaling
recknhqT4WSlXYkeE.summary: Brittany is a career and executive coach who helps people find work that fits their interests and values, apply for it effectively, and then succeed in the role. She holds a master's in industrial and organizational psychology and a certificate in executive coaching.

reckHi2iLQw8tGr5L.name: Annette Lagunes
reckHi2iLQw8tGr5L.summary: Annette is a lifestyle and wellness coach who guides women through a private 12-week reinvention of mind, body, and soul. Her approach is action-based and informed by lifestyle medicine, covering nutrition, movement, sleep, stress, and relationships.
reckHi2iLQw8tGr5L.ideal_client: Women navigating transitions, relationship strain, loss, an empty nest, career shifts, sleep trouble, or stress.
